metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow snagged 2 kills?! Valorant aim on vacation again
metadata.description:
Me: panic clicking like I lost my mouse
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-shock
How did I even get 2? No clue but I’m cashing in

Tap if your aim ever ghosts you but still lands the kill!
